name: ComprehensionAgent
description: Reads BRD documents and produces structured business scenarios via a five-step pipeline (parse, extract requirements, generate scenarios, validate, export). Supports flat and per-module modes. Invoked directly by DiscoveryAgent as a plain Python import, not only through the registry. Phase 1 (requirements.enabled): extracts quote-verified, classified, atomic acceptance criteria per BRD into test_comprehension/requirements.json via the shared tools/requirements core (one extra LLM call per BRD; declared ids kept; the LLM may add but never drop criteria) and links every scenario to its ac_ids (validated, similarity backfill).

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Resolved project.yaml requirements block {enabled, doc_id_patterns}; enabled=false (default) leaves behaviour unchanged

inputs.name: brd_dir
inputs.description: Path to BRD document or directory

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: List of {id, name, brd_file} dicts — presence switches to modular mode

outputs.name: requirements_json
outputs.description: test_comprehension/requirements.json — REQ → atomic AC with testability, P0–P3, risk tags, verified source_quote (requirements.enabled only)

outputs.name: requirements
outputs.description: Per-module extraction summary {status, requirements, criteria, rejected, limitations} (requirements.enabled only)
